en: A colorized historical postcard view of a busy European city square. In the foreground stands a large monument with multiple statues and steps, surrounded by café tables and parasols. Old multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs and green window shutters line the square. A tram and horse-drawn carriages are visible. In the background, on a hill, there is a fortified structure with a prominent clock tower. Red printed text at the top reads in German: "Graz. Hauptplatz mit Schlossberg."
